label: same-field genus-3 Jacobian image: four-size cold transfer/solver panel
description: Preregistered toy panel for the pinned n=83 cubic-pullback workstream. Three substantive arms compare the strong source rho with deterministic rho and BSGS on the exact genus-3 Jacobian image; the fourth arm is the source-rho A/A wall control. Destination operations remain unpriced in source GAE, so this is a transfer and engineering diagnostic, not a speedup claim.
